note: Two distinct legal entities were submitted as one line; they are assessed separately. (1) KLA INDIA PUBLIC LIMITED — export shipments CONFIRMED by dated customs/B-L records: 416 records claimed, 5 dated rows actually seen (2026-02-19 to 2026-02-28), destinations Mozambique (Beira), Kuwait (Shuaiba), Djibouti, South Africa (Durban), Togo (Lome), B-L numbers 1127893, 1050271, 9977744, 9866775, 9828146. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 071021/071022/071030/071080 (frozen vegetables) does NOT match the actual shipped goods — all visible records are HS 10063099 / 10063019 (rice, semi-milled or wholly milled). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS code should be corrected to the factual 1006.30 (rice) range, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: appears to be a manufacturer/exporter of rice (own brand KLA, plus brand SARA GOLD), also appears as buyer in some lanes — likely manufacturer_trader. (2) BRK COMMODITY INDIA LIMITED — no shipment records found: ImportKey pages for slugs brk-commodity-india-limited, brk-commodity-india-pvt-ltd and brk-commodities-india-limited all returned an empty record table ("Loading..." / "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records") with zero rows and zero counters. Volza and Eximpedia returned HTTP 403, so no second source could be checked. No export or domestic supply traces found for BRK Commodity India Limited — status none_found, not 'conditionally accepted'. Note: the two names may be a mis-merged record (possibly a buyer/consignee line or an unrelated trader); recommend re-verification of the exact legal name and CIN before use.
